limitations: Native proprietary skill/AI/notify execution code not present in this analysis.
Rate is raw selection weight, not verified absolute probability.
Notify count is not hit count.
Range/height interpreted as UE distance fields (likely cm) but original custom consumer conversion not inspected.
bUse true and Rate positive identify configured general candidates, not a guarantee of selection in every runtime condition.
Omitted cooked EventTag, Group, SkillActionType fields are left missing; native defaults have not been verified.
DilationAnimPositions presence and playback mapping do not establish live gameplay actor/attack-speed timing.
Hit-rate/HP fixed-point scale and comparison inclusive/exclusive boundary are native consumer semantics not supplied by these JSON exports.
